subject: Renewal: Regional isolation + Singapore on‑prem enclave addition
messages:
From: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@nexabank.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@nexabank.com>, procurement@nexabank.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 07:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Renewal coming up — want to add SG on‑prem & geo isolation at term

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re well. Our renewal for Redwood Private is coming up in January and we’re evaluating two additions before we sign:

- Add a Singapore on‑prem enclave (air‑gapped option) to support our APAC latency and compliance needs.
- Apply geofence isolation so EU and APAC workloads are strictly separated (separate clusters, no cross‑region KV cache).

We’re also looking at extending the term to 24 months and increasing committed throughput by ~2x across the private footprint. Can you send an outline of the procurement steps, an updated SOW estimate, and any SOC2/compliance notes that will be required for on‑prem deployment?

I attached a rough network diagram and the SOW template we prefer (attached). Budget owners want a ballpark cost and timeline by next week so I can start approvals.

Thanks,
Amira Hassan
Head of Cloud Platforms
NexaBank
amira.hassan@nexabank.com
+65 9123 4567

Attachments: Nexa_SOW_draft_v1.pdf, diagram_sg_onprem.png

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
To: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@nexabank.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — want to add SG on‑prem & geo isolation at term

Hi Amira — thanks for the clear ask and the diagram.

Short answer: we can do both. High level next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm isolation model (separate VPCs + dedicated clusters per region vs. tenancy partitioning).
2) Scope SG on‑prem: rack space, KMS integration, and whether you want fully air‑gapped or managed private control plane.
3) Draft SOW with capacity and term options (12/24/36 months) and estimated lead times.

I’m looping in Monica (CS) for rollout scheduling and Ben (sales) for commercial. Marcus from Solutions will scope the SG on‑prem technical checklist. I’ll follow up with a draft SOW and a procurement checklist by EOD Friday.

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

Team — quick commercial notes:
- If they commit to a 24‑month term at ~2x throughput we can offer a tiered discount + 1 quarter of onboarding credits for the SG enclave.
- On‑prem air‑gapped option requires a separate support SKU (oncall+onsite runbook) — estimate +$30k one‑time and +$6k/mo.
- Separate clusters per region will increase baseline node count; I’ll run a proper quote once Marcus confirms vCPU/GPU counts and expected QPS.

Action: Marcus, can you confirm the minimum cluster topology for strict geofence (no cross‑region KV) — preferred replica counts and HA? Monica, we’ll want to include a phased rollout plan in the SOW.

— Ben

Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Renewal coming up — want to add SG on‑prem & geo isolation at term

Ben / Hannah / Monica —

Preliminary technical read: for strict isolation with independent KV caches and no cross‑region failover, we should provision:
- EU cluster: 6x A100 nodes (or equivalent), 2 replicas for control plane.
- SG on‑prem enclave: minimum 4x A40/A100 nodes depending on model families, segmented network, local KMS with HSM passthrough.
- Dedicated ingress gateways per region and explicit routing policies — no shared prefixes.

Estimated lead time for SG on‑prem (hardware procurement + secure network validation): 8–10 weeks.
I attached a short checklist (network + KMS + rack requirements) and the initial sizing sheet (nexa_network_requirements.xlsx).

If they plan to 2x throughput across the footprint we should size for burst capacity too — recommend a buffer of +25% on the baseline nodes.

Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: nexa_network_requirements.xlsx

From: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@nexabank.com>

Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@nexabank.com>, procurement@nexabank.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 02:40:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal coming up — want to add SG on‑prem & geo isolation at term

Thanks Hannah, Ben and Marcus — this is helpful. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- SG on‑prem must be air‑gapped except for the update window; we will require a documented patching procedure and approved outbound IPs.
- Procurement prefers a single SOW with clear line items (hardware, install, monthly support, term discount).
- We may be able to sign for 24 months but need approximate CapEx vs OpEx splits for internal CFO review.

I’ll get the budget window confirmed and loop in facilities for rack details. Can you include an estimate for a short 4‑week pilot (1 rack, smaller node count) in the SOW? That would help expedite approvals.

— Amira

Amira — quick update and next steps:

1) Commercial & SOW: Ben and I prepared a draft SOW that includes a 24‑month option, a 4‑week pilot line item (pilot: 1 rack, 2 nodes), and the on‑prem support SKU. I’ve attached the draft SOW and a line‑by‑line cost table to the shared Drive link.
2) Compliance: I attached our SOC2 summary and an on‑prem checklist (we’ll run an onsite security attestation during install).
3) Timeline: If we get sign by Dec 18, hardware order + validation should allow a pilot kickoff the week of Feb 1 and full SG enclave in late March.
4) Procurement: Rajiv / procurement — please review and confirm if DocuSign route is acceptable; Ben will follow up on discounting for the 24‑month commit.

Action items for you (Amira): confirm pilot approval and whether KMS will be customer‑managed HSM or Redwood‑managed with HSM passthrough.

Thanks team — I’ll schedule a 30‑minute handshake call early next week to walk through the SOW.
